skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students grasp the basic knowledge about bonded warehouses in a market economy: nature, role, major functions and tasks of bonded warehouses, technical facilities of bonded warehouses, as well as the formation and regulations for organizing bonded warehouse activities.
Students understand and grasp the procedures for designing, operating, and evaluating the effectiveness of bonded warehouses.
Students have the ability to design, construct, and operate various types of bonded warehouses.
Students understand and grasp the methods for building import/export procedures for goods traded through bonded warehouses.
Students have knowledge in the field of government management of bonded warehouses, import/export procedures at bonded warehouses, and evaluation of the effectiveness of bonded warehouse operations.

Students have the ability to work independently, teamwork skills; through individual assignments, group assignments, students have the ability to write reports, present, and present contents related to customs in general and bonded warehouses for imported/exported goods in particular in a scientific manner.

Students have the ability to self-study and research, find materials to complete assigned lessons and assignments (group assignments and scenario assignments) on their own initiative, have a sense of discipline in class organization, follow classroom rules, have a cooperative spirit, and a personal sense of responsibility for activities assigned by the instructor.
